table.name: forecasting.run_line
table.label: Run line
table.description: One store × subcategory of a month's engine Run under review: the forecast, the AOP, its days and what each basis adds. Loaded in bulk (psql COPY) from the engine's output; people only read it.

columns.label: The forecast for each day (₹, JSON list)
Each basis: its share and value (JSON)

table.name: forecasting.reach
table.label: Reach
table.description: Who reviews what: each person's job, manager and the stores and subcategories they cover, worked out from the org chart and merchandise assignments as Dash's reach is. Loaded in bulk; people only read it.

table.name: forecasting.explanation
table.label: Explanation
table.description: Why a day sold more or less than its forecast: the causes picked and a note, for a store (or every store) and a level of the hierarchy.

table.name: forecasting.day_explanation
table.label: Day Explanation
table.description: Why a day went more than 10% below or above Feather Forecast, as the person who reviews it says: for a section's day, or one subcategory's day. A later explanation of the same day replaces the earlier one.

columns.label: Run
columns.description: The official Run whose month the day is in.

columns.label: Store Code
columns.description: The store, by its SAP code.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store, by its short code.

columns.label: Section
columns.description: The section the day belongs to.

columns.label: Subcategory
columns.description: The subcategory, for one subcategory's day; blank for the section's day.

columns.label: Day
columns.description: The day explained.

columns.label: Direction
columns.description: Whether the day went below or above Feather Forecast: each has its own causes, and the warehouse tells them apart by this.

columns.label: Causes
columns.description: One or more of the causes for the day's direction, one a line (src/causes.ts).

columns.label: Tags
columns.description: The detail under each cause, one a line, as Cause › Tag.

columns.label: What Happened
columns.description: What happened, and whether it carries into the coming days.

columns.label: Explained By
columns.description: Who explained it.

columns.label: Role
columns.description: Their role when they explained it.

table.name: forecasting.change_reason
table.label: Change Reason
table.description: Why a forecast change is asked for: the closed list a Team Leader or Store Manager picks from.

columns.label: Applies To
columns.description: A month change, a day change, or both.

table.name: forecasting.forecast_change_reason
table.label: Forecast Change Reason
table.description: One reason given for a forecast change.

table.name: forecasting.forecast_change
table.label: Forecast Change
table.description: A change someone asked for on a line's forecast: the whole month or one day, by a percent or to a value, with why. Immutable once sent; a revision is a new row that replaces it.

columns.label: Run
columns.description: The Feather Forecast run this row belongs to: the official run for the month.

columns.label: Store Code
columns.description: The store, by its SAP code.

columns.label: Scope
columns.description: The whole month, or one day.

columns.label: Day
columns.description: The day changed, for a day change.

columns.label: Method
columns.description: By a percent, or to a value.

columns.label: Feather Forecast (Before Tax)
columns.description: Feather Forecast for the scope when the change was sent.

columns.label: Changed Value (Before Tax)
columns.description: What the scope becomes with this change.

columns.label: Changed Quantity
columns.description: Pieces move with the value, at Feather Forecast's selling price.

columns.label: Explanation
columns.description: Why the forecast should change: what Feather Forecast cannot know.

columns.label: Replaces
columns.description: The change this one replaces.

columns.label: Batch
columns.description: Day changes entered together share a batch and are approved as one.

columns.label: Status
columns.choices:
draft
sent
approved
rejected
replaced
withdrawn

table.name: forecasting.forecast_line_review
table.label: Forecast Line Review
table.description: One person's answer on one line of a Run: accepted, or a change proposed. A later answer replaces the earlier one.

columns.label: Run
columns.description: The Feather Forecast run this row belongs to: the official run for the month.

columns.label: Store Code
columns.description: The store, by its SAP code.

columns.label: Answer
columns.description: Accepted, or a change proposed.

columns.label: Change
columns.description: The change proposed with this answer.

columns.label: Month
columns.description: The month of the Run the answer was given on, so a later official Run of the same month can carry it.

columns.label: Feather Forecast (Before Tax)
columns.description: Feather Forecast for the subcategory when the answer was given. A later Run that moves it by more than 10% asks for the answer again.

datasets.name: forecast_run
datasets.query: select run_id, model, purpose, status, origin_date, horizon_from, horizon_to from marts_forecasting.main.fb_forecast_run where run_id in (select run_id from (select run_id, row_number() over (partition by horizon_from, region order by origin_date desc, run_id desc) as newest from marts_forecasting.main.fb_forecast_run where purpose = 'official' and horizon_to >= date_trunc('month', current_date)) where newest = 1)
datasets.runKey: select string_agg(run_id, ',' order by run_id) as runs from (select run_id from (select run_id, row_number() over (partition by horizon_from, region order by origin_date desc, run_id desc) as newest from marts_forecasting.main.fb_forecast_run where purpose = 'official' and horizon_to >= date_trunc('month', current_date)) where newest = 1)

jobs.name: carry_changes
jobs.title: Carry Changes To A New Run
jobs.description: After a new load of the Run's monthly forecast: tells the people who had answered a subcategory this month that Feather Forecast moved by more than 10%, so they answer again (the review asks again on its own). Does nothing on its daily run.
